stories.title: B.C. officer tells of Myles Gray's 'brute strength' and lack of pain response
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — A Vancouver police officer who responded to a call for backup on the day Myles Gray was killed says he arrived at the scene and saw a colleague red in the face and barely conscious after being punched. Const.

stories.title: Canada following Ukraine’s Starshield difficulties ‘very closely’: defence minister
stories.summary: OTTAWA — Ukraine’s struggles with the Starshield military satellite network show why Canada is pursuing its own sovereign low-Earth orbit satellite network, Defence Minister David McGuinty said Tuesday.

stories.title: Raptors forward Leonard out at least another week with knee swelling
stories.summary: TORONTO — The Toronto Raptors will be without forward Kawhi Leonard for at least another week as he deals with swelling in his left knee.

stories.title: Apple joins a parade of technology hiccups in recent days
stories.summary: An update gone awry Tuesday at Apple followed a rash of major outages in recent days, including problems affecting the Federal Aviation Administration, United Airlines and Microsoft.

stories.title: Manning-led report says Western Canada can unite, gain power within Confederation
stories.summary: CALGARY — A report examining the future of Western Canada suggests provinces should seek more sovereignty and provincial control rather than consider leaving Canada.

stories.title: Nvidia chairman says board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia Chairman Harvey Jones said Tuesday that the company's board of directors does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, a statement that came hours after Huang said he would come back to lead the chipmaker if the board invited him.

stories.title: Mississauga data centre moratorium challenged by U.S. real estate giant, Toronto firm
stories.summary: Mississauga's data centre moratorium is set to face a legal challenge, as a U.S. real estate giant and a Toronto asset manager move to overturn the pause at the Ontario Land Tribunal.
